title: CFP Control List
intro: The work list behind the failure-point register. Each action closes one or more root-cause failure points; when an action is verified, the register updates itself. A builder agent does the work in an isolated branch, the reviewer verifies it, and only the items marked Needs you wait for you.

waves.name: Triage and setup
waves.goal: Handle upstream's reply to note 26 and stand up this list.

waves.name: Code-only hardening
waves.goal: Close the failure points that need code and tests only. No cost, no change to Friday's or Saturday's job behaviour.

waves.name: Measurement foundation
waves.goal: Measure what is unmeasured (non-deadline facts, awards) and grow the answer key. About 30 cents in cheap-model calls.

waves.name: Live evidence
waves.goal: Read the first live runs of the new job steps and decide from evidence. Tied to the calendar.

waves.name: Upstream batch
waves.goal: Everything that only upstream can close, drafted for you to send.
